chunk_text: The house whose lord is in Vriddhavastha (i.e. of an old age) is ineffective from the view point of good results. A planet between 18 and 24 degrees of an odd sign or between 6 and 12 degrees of an even sign is said to be in such an Avastha.
If a planet is in Mritavastha (in extremis) its bhava will be destroyed. This state refers to a planet in the first 6 degrees of an even sign or in the last 6 degrees of an odd sign.
Lastly, a planet in Suptavastha neutralises the effects of the bhava. This Avastha is due to a debilitated planet or the one in an inimical camp.
The bhava occupied or aspected by the Moon undergoes good or bad effects. That is, if the Moon is increasing, good effects will increase; otherwise effects will diminish.
Should the ascendant lord be a malefic or be in the 8th, 6th or 12th, physical felicity will diminish.
